claim: Meaning can be operationalized as deterministic layered structure preserved per byte under compression.

scenarios.name: identity_flip
scenarios.purpose: Identity changed; current value, history, contradiction, volatility, and bit flags must survive.

scenarios.name: employer_correction
scenarios.purpose: Current employer must supersede prior employer while preserving the contradiction.

scenarios.name: authority_boundary
scenarios.purpose: A social/provisional claim must remain non-answerable and keep its authority flag.

scenarios.name: policy_constraint
scenarios.purpose: A locked action policy must survive compression as a refusal policy.

scenarios.name: concern_preference
scenarios.purpose: A non-contradiction meaning layer must survive: concern plus preference.
